_comment: Remix / forge constructor args. FeeSplitter: per-seller. FeeSplitterFactory: one deploy per chain (sellers via CREATE2). Do not commit secrets. Optimizer runs=200 to match src/fee-splitter-bytecode.ts.

FeeSplitterFactory.notes: After deploy set FACTORY_ADDRESS. Call getOrCreate(seller) before first ≥$10 settle. Gateway predictAddress must use same feeCollector/asset/feeBps.

threshold.meaning: Single payment amount < 10 USDC (6 decimals) → payTo = seller EOA; ≥ → CREATE2 FeeSplitter
